children.text: Inspect release versions, serving endpoints, and software provenance.
Inspect candidate versions, endpoint records and recorded release evidence.

Reviewed CPU candidates export actual verified model bytes. Other exports may contain metadata only. Local CPU serving is available after a passing frozen review and actual readiness probe. Production qualification remains unavailable.
Freeze an actual trained candidate, its complete held-out evaluation and local export criteria.
Candidate records and effective states returned by the API.
Authenticated local CPU serving. Startup probes and deployment failures are retained; check live health after interruptions.
